title: Valid coupon reduces subtotal and shows discount line
objective: Verify a valid 10% coupon reduces a 100.00 EUR subtotal by 10.00 EUR and is shown as a separate line
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR; shipping 4.99 EUR
test_data: Coupon SAVE10 (10%, valid, unused by shopper)
steps: 1. Open checkout | 2. Enter SAVE10 | 3. Click Apply
expected_result: Summary shows line 'Discount (SAVE10) -10.00 EUR'; subtotal after discount 90.00 EUR; shipping 4.99 EUR; total 94.99 EUR; updated without page reload

title: Percentage boundaries 5% and 50% are applied
objective: Verify the minimum and maximum documented percentages compute correctly
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR
test_data: Coupons PCT5 (5%) and PCT50 (50%), each on a fresh cart
steps: 1. Apply PCT5 and note discount | 2. On a new cart apply PCT50 and note discount
expected_result: PCT5: discount 5.00 EUR; PCT50: discount 50.00 EUR

title: Discount is rounded to cents
objective: Verify rounding of a fractional discount (assumption A-3: half-up to 0.01)
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 33.33 EUR
steps: 1. Open checkout | 2. Enter PCT15 | 3. Click Apply
expected_result: Discount 5.00 EUR and subtotal after discount 28.33 EUR (per A-3; confirm with Q-3)

title: Subtotal just below minimum is rejected
objective: Verify 29.99 EUR is rejected with the documented message
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 29.99 EUR
expected_result: Message 'Minimum order of 30.00 EUR not reached'; no discount line; total unchanged

title: Subtotal exactly at minimum is accepted
objective: Verify 30.00 EUR is accepted (assumption A-1: minimum is inclusive)
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 30.00 EUR
expected_result: Discount 3.00 EUR applied; subtotal after discount 27.00 EUR (per A-1; confirm with Q-1)

title: Expired coupon is rejected
objective: Verify a coupon that expired yesterday is rejected with the documented message
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR
expected_result: Message 'This coupon has expired'; no discount applied

title: Coupon on its last valid day is accepted
objective: Verify the expiry boundary (assumption A-4: valid until 23:59:59 store time on the expiry date)
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR; clock controllable or coupon expiring today
steps: 1. Enter LAST10 before end of day | 2. Click Apply
expected_result: Discount applied (per A-4; confirm timezone with Q-4)

title: Second coupon is not stacked
objective: Verify only one coupon can be active on an order
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR; SAVE10 already applied
expected_result: Only one discount line exists; total reflects a single coupon (replace vs reject behaviour pending Q-6)

title: Shopper cannot reuse a coupon
objective: Verify a coupon already used in a placed order is rejected for the same shopper
preconditions: Shopper placed an order with SAVE10; new cart subtotal 100.00 EUR
steps: 1. Start a new checkout | 2. Enter SAVE10 | 3. Click Apply
expected_result: Coupon rejected with an error message (text undefined, Q-9); no discount applied

title: Another shopper can use the same coupon
objective: Verify the once-per-shopper limit is per shopper, not global
preconditions: Shopper A used SAVE10; shopper B logged in with subtotal 100.00 EUR
steps: 1. As shopper B enter SAVE10 | 2. Click Apply
expected_result: Discount 10.00 EUR applied for shopper B

title: Shipping cost is never discounted
objective: Verify the percentage applies to the subtotal only
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR; shipping 4.99 EUR
steps: 1. Open checkout | 2. Enter PCT50 | 3. Click Apply | 4. Read the order summary
expected_result: Discount 50.00 EUR; shipping remains 4.99 EUR; total 54.99 EUR

title: Unknown coupon code is rejected
objective: Verify a non-existent code shows an error and leaves totals unchanged
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR
expected_result: Error message shown (text undefined, Q-9); totals unchanged

title: Coupon code case and whitespace handling
objective: Verify behaviour for ' save10 ' (lower case with spaces)
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR
expected_result: Behaviour matches the answer to Q-5 (accepted after normalization, or rejected as unknown)

title: Apply with empty code
objective: Verify an empty code does not change the order
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items
steps: 1. Leave the code empty | 2. Click Apply
expected_result: No discount; validation hint or disabled Apply button; no error page

title: Cart drops below minimum after coupon applied
objective: Verify behaviour when items are removed after a coupon is applied
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 40.00 EUR; SAVE10 applied
steps: 1. Apply SAVE10 | 2. Remove the 15.00 EUR item
expected_result: Coupon removed or invalidated with the minimum-order message; total recalculated (expected behaviour pending Q-8)

title: Rule precedence when several rejections apply
objective: Verify which message is shown when a coupon is both expired and below the minimum
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 20.00 EUR
expected_result: Exactly one rejection message is shown; no discount applied (order of precedence pending Q-10)

title: Double click on Apply applies the discount once
objective: Verify duplicate submissions do not double the discount
preconditions: Shopper logged in; cart contains items with subtotal 100.00 EUR
expected_result: One discount line of 10.00 EUR; total 90.00 EUR plus shipping
